about: Meshy Retexture scope (read by work/remaster/tools/meshy/pack.py). One part = one Meshy multiview job = one retail texture. glb/material/meshes: the representative game meshes (paths under work/out/); extraSources: more game meshes on the SAME texture packed into the same pack glb (their UV islands differ, so Meshy must see them all); layout "spread": extra sources are placed side by side with node translations (vertex bytes untouched); sharedWith: other game glbs whose material uses this texture with byte-identical UVs (not packed; install.py writes the result for them too). rotation: null, "upright" (glTF -90 deg about X: +Z tip up), "shield-front" (the shield face toward the front camera) or a quaternion [x,y,z,w]. tier/priority: firing order (work/tmp/w9-meshy-scope.md). coverage: share of the texture union covered by each packed or shared mesh (256x256 UV raster).

selection.bodies: first 3 male and first 3 female Chinese models in creation order (PLAYER_MODELS_CH, packages/shared/src/protocol.ts)
selection.items: Chinese weapons, shields and armour (garment/protector/armor, male and female, head/shoulders/chest/legs/hands/feet) in work/out/equipment/equipment.json with reqLevel <= 20, deduped by source texture (.ddj)
selection.excluded: the *_CA_* items have no model; textures used only by items above level 20 (e.g. *_03_ba) are out of scope; terrain has its own local pipeline
